children: Phenom reported initial assays from its Dobbin Gold Project: hole DDH26-02 returned 3.59 g/t gold over 15.24 metres, including 18.20 g/t over 1.22 metres. Results are from the first three of 11 holes completed; assays for the other eight are pending.
A substantial gold intercept provides initial evidence of mineralization at Dobbin; only three of 11 holes have reported assays.
The high-grade interval adds potential value, though it is narrow and does not establish deposit scale or economics.
A second hole also returned gold mineralization, but the release provides no prior results for comparison.
Assays pending for eight of 11 holes
Further results may clarify continuity and scale; the next assay releases are potential near-term catalysts.
Drilling expected to resume in spring 2027
Weather halted the program, delaying follow-up drilling until spring.

These are early-stage exploration results, with assays available for only three of 11 completed holes and no established resource disclosed. Results from the remaining holes and follow-up drilling planned for spring 2027 would be needed to assess continuity and scale.
